# Third-party files

The look of this site follows the [Godot Engine documentation](https://docs.godotengine.org).
These files come from the [godot-docs](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs) repository:

- `css/custom.css`, `js/custom.js` and `../_templates/layout.html` (adapted), licensed under
  [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) by the Godot Engine community.
- `../_extensions/gdscript.py` and `../_extensions/classref_admonitions.py`, MIT license.
- `css/fonts/`: Inter and JetBrains Mono, SIL Open Font License 1.1.

`../tools/godot/` holds Godot's class reference converter (`doc/tools/make_rst.py` and its
helpers), MIT license; see `../tools/godot/LICENSE.txt`.

This is not an official Godot Engine site.
